Class Machine

java.lang.Object
org.example.Machine
public class Machine extends Object
Represents a machine that performs a specific operation for a given amount of time. Each machine has a unique identifier, an operation name, and the time it takes to complete that operation. The machine also tracks when it will be available to perform the next operation.

  • Method Details

    • fromCSV

      public static Machine fromCSV(String csvLine)
      Factory method to create a Machine instance from a CSV line. The CSV line should have the following format: idMachine;operationName;time

      If the CSV line does not contain exactly three fields, or if the time value is invalid, an IllegalArgumentException will be thrown.

      Parameters:
      csvLine - a string representing a line from a CSV file
      Returns:
      a new Machine object created from the CSV data
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the CSV line format is invalid or if the time value is invalid
